These pinned browser libraries are served locally and loaded only when needed.
No file contents are sent to a third party.

- PDF.js 6.5.438: `pdfjs-dist` from the npm registry; Apache-2.0.
  `pdfjs/LICENSE` and the license notices in its font/CMap directories apply.
  https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
- SheetJS CE 0.20.3: `xlsx.full.min.js` from the official SheetJS CDN;
  Apache-2.0, see `SHEETJS-LICENSE`.
  https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/
- fflate 0.8.3: `fflate` from the npm registry; MIT, see `fflate/LICENSE`.
  https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate
